route: ordinary native PD; no seed/adoption or local completion
scope: Fixed finite workloads and numeric tasks; full sequences retained, no general quality/capacity acceptance.

source.selection: First native block, no post-result best/worst-block selection

fixed_arrival_control.condition: Same external arrivals in all4 blocks;32 client workers permit legitimate queueing instead of completion-coupled resubmission. Original service max_num_seqs4 unchanged.
fixed_arrival_control.dispatch_gate: p95 delay<=10ms and max<=25ms in both modes; otherwise timing invalid. No unchanged benchmark repeat.
